title: Australian defence chief says China military buildup creating 'pressure' in Southeast Asia
paragraphs: Australian defence chief says China military buildup creating 'pressure' in Southeast Asia

"Now is a time to double down on friends and to double down on neighbours and to be working more closely together to provide for our collective security," said Australian Defence Minister Richard Marles.

CEBU: Australian Defence Minister Richard Marles said on Thursday (Oct 29) that China's military build-up was creating a "condition of pressure" in Southeast Asia, and urged allies and partners to deepen cooperation.
